id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

assetRelations.description: The {@link ReliabilityAsset}s for this Model Config Run

status.description: The status of the Model Config Run

models.description: The models created by this run

assetRelationsCount.description:
Represents the number of {@link ReliabilityAsset}s for this Model Config Run
This field is used to display the number of assets in the UI

lastUpdated.description:
Represents the last time that the model change the status
This field is used to display the number of models in the UI

project.description: The {@link ReliabilityMl.Project} related to this Model Config Run

errorMessage.description: Error message that will be populated with its corresponding error in the worfklow in the case of failure.

trainingJobRun.description:
The {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.TrainingJobRun} that trains the models for this run.
Will not be populated for Reliability Risk Model Config Runs.

hasPostTraining.description:
Whether or not the associated workflow has a post-training step.
Used for determining if the run is complete in the updateAfterWorkflow function.

title: Type to store info from a {@link Workflow.Run} being used for Model Config
